[Key Information from testbed/langflow-ai__langflow-5272_2026-06-06_14-40-54/DEVELOPMENT.md]

- Developer Setup:
  - Prerequisites:
    - OS: macOS or Linux (Windows users MUST develop under WSL).
    - git: for version control.
    - make: used to coordinate packaging and build tasks.
    - uv (>=0.4): Python package and project manager from Astral (install https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/).
    - Node.js (v22.12 LTS) and npm (v10.9) for frontend build (https://nodejs.org/en/download/package-manager).
      - For Windows WSL users: npm must be installed inside WSL.
  - Git setup:
    - Fork https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow.
    - Clone your fork: `git clone https://github.com/<your username>/langflow.git`
    - Add upstream remote:
      ```
      cd langflow
      git remote add upstream https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow.git
      git remote set-url --push upstream no_push
      ```
    - Windows/WSL workaround for file mode: `git config core.filemode false`
  - Environment Options:
    - Preferred: Use Dev Container in IDE (VS Code supported).
    - Alternate: Setup environment manually with above prerequisites.
  - Initialize environment and build everything:
    - Run `make init` to:
      - install backend and frontend dependencies,
      - build frontend static files,
      - initialize project,
      - start application (runs `uv run langflow run` internally).
    - Validate access UI at http://127.0.0.1:7860
  - Optional pre-commit hooks:
    - Install with:
      ```
      uv sync --dev
      uv run pre-commit install
      ```
    - When committing with hooks enabled, use: `uv run git commit`

- Running Development Services with Hot Reload:
  - Backend (FastAPI):
    - Run `make backend` in Backend Terminal.
    - Server runs on http://0.0.0.0:7860
    - Health check: http://localhost:7860/health returns `{"status":"ok"}`
  - Frontend (Node.js dev server):
    - Run `make frontend` in Frontend Terminal.
    - Server runs on http://localhost:3000/
  - Documentation (optional):
    - In Documentation Terminal:
      ```
      cd docs
      npm install
      npm run start
      ```
    - Runs Docusaurus docs server (likely on http://localhost:3001/)

- Testing:
  - Run backend unit tests:
    - Command: `make unit_tests`
  - Important quirk:
    - The test `src/backend/tests/unit/test_database.py` may fail when run with `make tests`.
    - Recommended to run this test sequentially manually:
      ```
      uv run pytest src/backend/tests/unit/test_database.py
      ```
  - Additional test targets exist (`integration_tests`, `coverage`, `tests_frontend`) but require extra setup not described here.

- Linting and Formatting before commits:
  - `make lint`
  - `make format_backend`
  - `make format_frontend`

- Notes:
  - To clean build and validate project state before pushing:
    - Stop backend and frontend services.
    - Run `make init` again.
    - Confirm UI at port 7860.
  - When pre-commit hooks enabled, git commit commands must run within uv environment (`uv run git commit`).
